notes.title: Solid Match - Update V 1.7
Solid Match - Update V 1.1
notes.content:
Hi, guys!
We are very happy with all Feedbacks and Reviews we received so far!

In this update we fixed the following bugs:[list]
[*] The achievements "Hanoi Master" and "Half Master" was not being unlocked if the game is not finished in the first try.
[*] Fast click during the movement animation was causing double move.
[/list]

And we added two more achievements:[list]
[*] "I Found a shortcut!" (Solve a level with less moves than the sugested)
[*] "Shortcut Master" (Solve at least 5 levels with less moves than the sugested)
[/list]

We hope you like it!

Remember to Follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/HanoiStudios]studio`s page on Steam[/url], to know about our other games and receive news from us.

Thanks and happy holidays !
